title: Compositor language pack
description: A downloadable Compositor localization. The strings object maps immutable English source keys to translated values.

$schema.description: An optional JSON Schema reference for editor and tooling support.

language.description: The target language as a BCP 47 language code.

revision.description: A monotonically increasing version for this language.

strings.description: English source keys mapped to translations. Missing keys fall back to English.
